title: Page 4
content_zh:
消息来得太突然，连身为当事人的佟映晨也被他无预警的举动吓了一小跳，不过还是比众人更早从惊讶中恢复过来，仰脸对他绽露一抹开心的笑容——
“明早我就带律师去找你。”
“未来的老婆，你真会杀风景。”
开口闭口都是公司的事……这女人的确是他哥的翻版没错！
第2章(1)
三个月后，杜天海和佟映晨在少数至亲好友的见证下，举行了简单的结婚仪式。
虽说这场婚礼准备了三个月，但其实这三个月里准新郎和准新娘之间并没有太多交集，他们签完协定后就各忙各的，除了一起见过双方家长外，连试礼服都是各自抽空完成，几乎把整个婚礼过程都交由婚顾公司处理。反正有钱好办事，业者遇上完全没意见的新人倒也乐得轻松赚钱。
婚礼结束后，他们回到杜家两老为儿子购置来当作新房的豪宅里，和一年多前结婚的杜家长子对门而居，开始他们的新婚生活——
“你要睡在这里吗？”新婚之夜，新娘卸完妆，洗完澡，隔着一张大床问新郎。
“不然你觉得我应该睡在哪里？”杜天海笑咪咪地反问她，觉得身为新郎的自己应该没有走错房、认错床。
“老实说，我觉得我们不应该睡在一起，你很清楚我们之间是什么关系。”佟映晨直言不讳地说出自己的想法。他们俩虽然名为夫妻，但实际上并不算太熟，睡在一起岂不尴尬。
“很清楚……我们是新婚夫妻呀！要不要我拿结婚证书给你看？”他故意装傻，向来没有什么体谅人的好心肠。
老实说，见她愈不自在，他就愈觉得他们应该睡在一起才对。
佟映晨轻蹙双眉，看他好像还是没弄懂，于是再次重申：“那张结婚证书跟借据没两样，我不是说我们的婚姻只是一桩各取所需的交易——”
“无关任何感情因素。”他替她说完，没忘记她的主张，因为那也是他决定娶她的一大主因。比起那些成天说爱他的女人，他认为这个直接找他谈钱的女人，更适合当他的妻子。双方把条件谈拢，一切都好办多了。
“你记得就好。”她松了口气，幸亏他还记得三个月前的事。
“不过有没有感情是一回事，睡不睡在一起又是另一回事。我不记得我有答应过你，结婚后不用履行夫妻间应尽的义务。”他坏坏地笑着，视线暖味地往她身上扫了一遍……
看到她那副正经八百的模样，他就忍不住想拿些不正经的事来刺激一下那颗保守的心脏。
“可是……”她下意识地揪着睡衣，略侧过身，想闪避他“有色”的目光。
“可是什么？难道你跟我求婚前都没想过这些事？”他一副讶异的口吻，使她更显窘态。

佟映晨一时语塞，其实之前还真没仔细想过这方面的事。一方面是因为她这几个月都在设法改善公司营运状况，另一方面则是因为他说过婚后会继续在女人堆里打滚，她便直觉地认为他不差她这一个女人来尽这种“义务”……
“天啊，你该不会以为只要盖个章、拎着行李搬过来住，什么事都不必管、不用做，就可以轻轻松松赖掉几千万吧？”明知她不是，他却把话说得更夸张，将她形容得像个存心占人便宜的坏女人，而自己是个误上贼船的受害者。
“我没有这么想！”她连忙澄清自己绝不是那种人。现在信用对她来说可是非常重要的资产，况且她目前也正在准备要偿还给他的第一笔款项了。
“有也没关系。如果你现在后悔了，我们明天就可以去办理离婚手续，取消这笔交易，反正买卖都有七天鉴赏期，我也不会跟你计较这场婚礼的花费，只要你把我借你的钱全数还清就行了。”
他无所谓地耸耸肩，很大方的给她出尔反尔的机会，只要她把他用个人名义替她清偿的那些钱全部还清，他也乐意马上恢复单身。
说完，他掀开被子，慢条斯理地爬上床。
“不，我没后悔。”她哪有本钱后悔。他明明知道她现在没有那么多钱可以还他，当然不可能有第二种选择，否则当初就不会对他提出结婚的要求。
“我可没有逼你喔。”话是这么说，他嘴角却爬上一抹既贼又邪的笑意，简直像个逼人跳海的海盗一样。
她望着他那张带着恶魔气质的英俊脸庞，心里不由得又在“白目”那一栏划上一笔……
“对，你没逼我。”她很自愿地微笑，往床上一躺。“来吧——”
他一愣，坐在床上看着她出人意料的举动。
“要就快呀！你不是要我履行夫妻间应尽的义务吗？”她认命地闭上眼，两手一摊，准备任他摆布，速战速决。
是啊，是她要求跟他结婚的，当然要尽为人妻的义务喽！
杜天海看着身边躺成“火”字形的妻子，真的整个人都“兴奋”了起来……
“噗——哈哈哈……”他捧腹狂笑，笑到飙泪，真不明白这个一板一眼的女人为何总能创造出这么有趣的笑点。
老天，这女人太妙了！瞧她仰起脸、神情壮烈、全身僵硬——这哪叫尽义务？根本是“慷慨赴义”嘛！
杜天海边笑边擦泪，还是第一次遇见跟他上床像要上断头台的女人，心想她这勉为其难也表现得太突出、太显眼了，实在是有点伤他的男性自尊啊……
“笑什么？”她睁开眼睛看着他，不懂自己这么有诚意地配合他的要求，为何会换来他一阵大笑。
“没什么，只是觉得你这个人很有意思。”看她仍是一脸认真，他头一次觉得严肃竟也可以是种讨人喜欢的个性。
可爱的严肃、有趣的拘谨……这些突兀的形容，在这女人身上似乎都成了讨他开心的特质。

很有意思……他是什么意思？听起来好像是在损她耶！
佟映晨觉得这男人的言行常让她摸不着边，愈认真想就愈费疑猜……
“不过——”他突然扑到她身上，手肘撑在她脸旁，鼻尖近得几乎碰上她的。“今天就纯睡觉吧，等我有进一步的需要会再告诉你的，老婆。”
他英气逼人的脸庞挂着轻佻的笑容，温热的气息拂过她的唇，掺着一股淡淡的薄荷清香。
这措手不及的亲匿感害佟映晨全身紧绷，一颗心扑通扑通地跳……
“……喔。”她稍微别开脸，不看他那张英气逼人的脸孔，力持镇定地等他说完话自动离开。
怎料他才撑起手，拉开一点距离，马上又一脸玩味地盯着她。
“你怎么脸红了？”他的指背抚过嫣红的脸颊，眸中浮烁一丝戏谑。
“哦……我知道，不必那么害羞，如果你想要，这方面我也会尽力配合……”边说，他开始动手解自己的睡衣。
她紧张地倒抽口气，立刻使劲推开他——
“我不想！快睡吧。”她迅速钻进被子里，熄了床头灯，一点都没有要跟他尽夫妻义务的意思。
“真的不要？”他语气诱人地问，平常他可是鲜少配合别人的，今天难得大放送哦。
她把被子拉到下巴，索性再转过身去背对他，强烈地表达自己真的不需要他的好意。
“那晚安喽。”他也关了灯，闭上眼。
一片黑暗中，传出阵阵窃笑……
新婚之夜，他什么都没做，心情却意外地愉快。
同样的，他也没有后悔娶了这个女人。
content_en:
The news came so suddenly that even the person involved, Tong Yingchen, was startled by his unexpected move. However, he recovered from the surprise earlier than everyone else and looked up at him with a happy smile——
"I will bring a lawyer to you tomorrow morning."
"Future wife, you really know how to kill the scenery."
It's all the company's business to speak or speak... This woman is indeed the replica of his brother!
Chapter 2(1)
Three months later, Du Tianhai and Tong Yingchen held a simple wedding ceremony in the presence of a few close relatives and friends.
Although the wedding took three months to prepare, in fact, there was not much interaction between the groom-to-be and the bride-to-be during these three months. After signing the agreement, they went their separate ways. In addition to meeting their parents together, they even took their own time to try on dresses, leaving almost the entire wedding process to the wedding consulting company. Anyway, money makes things easier, and business owners are happy to make money easily when they meet new people who have no objections at all.
After the wedding, they returned to the mansion that the two elders of the Du family bought for their son as a new house. They lived across from the Du family, who had been married more than a year ago, and began their newlywed life——
"Do you want to sleep here?" On the wedding night, the bride took off her makeup and took a shower, and asked the groom across a big bed.
"Otherwise, where do you think I should sleep?" Du Tianhai asked her with a smile, feeling that as the groom, he should not have gone to the wrong room or the wrong bed.
"Honestly, I don't think we should sleep together. You know very well the relationship between us." Tong Yingchen said his thoughts bluntly. Although they are called husband and wife, they actually don't know each other very well, so it wouldn't be awkward to sleep together.
"It's very clear... we are newlyweds! Do you want me to show you the marriage certificate?" He deliberately pretended to be stupid, and he never had any considerate and kind heart.
To be honest, the more uncomfortable he saw her, the more he felt that they should sleep together.
Tong Yingchen frowned slightly, seeing that he still didn't understand, so he reiterated: "That marriage certificate is no different from an IOU. I'm not saying that our marriage is just a transaction where each gets what he needs-"
"It has nothing to do with any emotional factors." He finished for her, not forgetting her opinion, because that was also a major reason why he decided to marry her. Compared with those women who say they love him all the time, he thinks this woman who comes to him directly to talk about money is more suitable to be his wife. The two sides have agreed on the conditions, and everything will be much easier to handle.
"As long as you remember." She breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, he still remembered what happened three months ago.
"But whether we have feelings is one thing, whether we sleep together is another. I don't remember that I promised you that you don't have to fulfill the obligations between husband and wife after getting married." He smiled evilly and glanced at her warmly...
Seeing her serious look, he couldn't help but want to use some unseemly things to stimulate his conservative heart.
"But..." She subconsciously grabbed her pajamas and turned slightly to avoid his "colored" gaze.
"But what? Didn't you think about these things before proposing to me?" His surprised tone made her even more embarrassed.
Tong Yingchen was speechless for a moment. In fact, he had never thought about this aspect carefully before. On the one hand, it was because she had been trying to improve the company's operating conditions in the past few months, and on the other hand, because he had said that he would continue to hang out with women after marriage, she intuitively felt that he did not want her as a woman to fulfill this "obligation"...
"Oh my God, you don't think that you can easily get away with tens of millions as long as you get a stamp, carry your luggage and move here, without having to worry about or do anything, do you?" Knowing that she was not the case, he exaggerated his words even more, describing her as a bad woman who deliberately took advantage of others, and he was a victim who accidentally boarded a pirate ship.
"I didn't think so!" She quickly clarified that she was definitely not that kind of person. Credit to her nowBut it was a very important asset, and she was currently preparing to repay him the first payment.
"It doesn't matter. If you regret it now, we can go through the divorce procedures tomorrow and cancel the transaction. Anyway, there is a seven-day appreciation period for the transaction. I won't argue with you about the cost of this wedding. As long as you pay back all the money I loaned you."
He shrugged indifferently and generously gave her the opportunity to go back on her word. As long as she paid back all the money he had used to pay for her in his own name, he would be happy to return to being single immediately.
After saying that, he opened the quilt and climbed into bed slowly.
"No, I don't regret it." How could she regret it? He clearly knew that she didn't have that much money to pay him back now, so of course there was no second option, otherwise she wouldn't have asked him to get married in the first place.
"I'm not forcing you." As he said this, a thief and evil smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, just like a pirate forcing someone to jump into the sea.
She looked at his handsome face with a demonic temperament, and couldn't help but put a mark in the "white eyes" column...
"Yes, you didn't force me." She smiled willingly and lay down on the bed. "Come on -"
He was stunned and sat on the bed watching her unexpected move.
"Hurry up if you want! Don't you want me to fulfill my obligations as a husband and wife?" She closed her eyes in resignation, spread her hands, and was ready to let him do his bidding and make a quick decision.
Yes, it was she who asked to marry him. Of course she must fulfill her obligations as a wife!
Du Tianhai looked at his wife lying next to him in the shape of a "fire", and he really became "excited"...
"Pfft-hahaha..." He laughed wildly and burst into tears. He really didn't understand how this strict woman could always create such interesting jokes.
God, this woman is amazing! Look at her with her face raised, her expression majestic, and her whole body stiff - how can this be called fulfilling her duty? It’s basically “generous for righteousness”!
Du Tianhai laughed and wiped his tears. This was the first time he met a woman who felt like going to the guillotine to sleep with him. He thought that her reluctance was too prominent and conspicuous, and it really hurt his male self-esteem...
"Why are you laughing?" She opened her eyes and looked at him, wondering why she would make him laugh when she cooperated with his request so sincerely.
"It's nothing, I just think you are very interesting." Seeing that she still looked serious, he felt for the first time that seriousness could be a lovable personality.
Lovely seriousness, interesting restraint... These abrupt descriptions seemed to be qualities that made him happy in this woman.
Interesting...what did he mean? It sounds like he is hurting her!
Tong Yingchen felt that this man's words and deeds often confused her, and the more she thought about it, the more doubts she became...
"But-" He suddenly jumped on her, resting his elbow on her face, and the tip of his nose was so close that it almost touched hers. "Just sleep today. I will tell you if I need anything further, wife."
There was a frivolous smile on his heroic face, and his warm breath brushed her lips, mixed with a faint fragrance of mint.
This unexpected kiss caused Tong Yingchen's whole body to tense up and her heart to beat...
"...Oh." She turned away slightly, not looking at his heroic face, and waited calmly for him to leave automatically after he finished speaking.
Unexpectedly, he held up his hands, opened a little distance, and immediately stared at her with a playful expression.
"Why are you blushing?" He stroked his blushing cheeks with the back of his fingers, a trace of teasing flashing in his eyes.
"Oh...I know, don't be so shy. If you want it, I will try my best to cooperate in this regard..." As he said this, he began to unbutton his pajamas.
She gasped nervously and immediately pushed him away——
"I don't want to! Go to sleep." She quickly got into the quilt and turned off the bedside lamp, not wanting to follow him at all.It means fulfilling the obligations of husband and wife.
"Really?" He asked in a seductive tone. Usually he rarely cooperates with others, but today it's rare for him to show off.
She pulled the quilt up to her chin and simply turned her back to him, strongly expressing that she really didn't need his kindness.
"Good night then." He also turned off the light and closed his eyes.
In the darkness, there were bursts of snickering...
On the wedding night, he did nothing but was in an unexpectedly happy mood.
Likewise, he did not regret marrying this woman.
